text:
POV: your agent has been on the same task for nine minutes and you assume it is thinking.

You open the trace. It is reading the same config file for the fourth time. The path picks up a trailing newline from the env var, the read fails, and the retry hands the same broken path straight back.

Every attempt logs as INFO. Nothing crashes. The spinner just keeps spinning.

You fix it with .strip(). Nine minutes of model time for a bug the trace showed you in ten seconds.
